summary: Comprehensive auth testing completed for JARVIS AI. All 11 backend pytest cases pass (signup, duplicate-409, signin, wrong-password-401, brute-force-429 throttle, /auth/me valid + 401 for no/invalid token, Google upsert-by-email, guest). All frontend UI flows pass: email signup redirects to (tabs), token persisted in localStorage, session survives page reload (no bounce to /auth), sign-in with the same credentials succeeds, validation correctly disables the submit button for invalid email / short password / missing name, Google button correctly triggers window.location redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<app_url>/ (NO more placeholder Alert), and Guest login lands on (tabs). AuthContext ReferenceError for signInEmail/signUpEmail is fixed (imports present, no runtime errors observed).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: repeatedly logged on auth screen (likely in AIOrb / secondaryBtn styles).
React Native Web deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: same page load.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — the suggested example email 'test+<ts>@jarvis.test' is rejected by Pydantic's EmailStr (email-validator blocks the reserved .test TLD with HTTP 422). Suggest '@example.com' or a real-looking domain for testing docs.
(Optional/minor) Migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.tsx correctly imports signInEmail/signUpEmail from @/src/api/client and exposes signInWithEmail/signUpWithEmail — the previously reported ReferenceError is fixed.

googleAuth.ts correctly performs a full-page redirect on web (window.location.href = https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...) and AuthContext parses session_id from the return URL BEFORE routing decisions, so the OAuth return path works even though app/index.tsx eagerly routes.
Backend /api/auth/google uses upsert-by-email (find_one on email; only insert if missing) so re-authenticating the same Google email returns the same user_id — verified by test.
Signin path uses passlib bcrypt + constant-time dummy verify on missing user, plus a 5-attempt-in-1-hour lockout (15 min block). Behaviour verified by tests.
Backend uses Pydantic EmailStr which rejects reserved TLDs like .test — worth noting for docs; real user emails are unaffected.
Backend does not modify user-facing UI; only server.py auth endpoints were exercised.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_flow.py (new pytest suite for all auth endpoints)

rca_of_issue: Reported bugs (AuthContext ReferenceError on email auth; Google button showing placeholder Alert) are both fixed. Verified: (1) AuthContext.tsx imports signInEmail/signUpEmail correctly and Ctx type exposes signInWithEmail/signUpWithEmail — no runtime ReferenceError seen; email signup + signin succeed end-to-end and mint valid Bearer tokens accepted by /api/auth/me. (2) auth-google-btn onPress calls startGoogleLogin() which on web does window.location.href = 'https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/' — captured framenavigated URL was https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fzen-research-ai.preview.emergentagent.com%2F, which Emergent then forwards to Google's OAuth screen. No Firebase placeholder Alert observed.
